column1: name|want|fear|mistaken_belief|competence|harm_or_cost|decisive_chapters|independent_relationship|voice|private_life|end_state

Nil|A repair apprenticeship and an unrenegotiated bed|That uncertainty makes them disposable|Being the correct useful answer will secure belonging|Notices channels, mechanical faults and precise inconsistencies|Overstates a tentative comparison and freezes a cooperative reserve; must correct it publicly|1,4,16,17,26,43,49|Vesper's concealment makes trust costly; Maeve learns to ask instead of fixing them|Short concrete questions; silently counts under stress; becomes more direct when refusing; never a walking equation glossary|Keeps usable screws and likes the first clean click of a repaired mechanism|Chooses paid apprenticeship rather than office, retains name and bodily autonomy, accepts limits to what repair can return

Vesper|Keep the new group alive without letting it examine her past|That honesty will end the relationships she relies on|Protection and charm can substitute for accountability|Reads tells, plans exits, handles an actual loaded seven-chamber weapon|Her rigged hand harmed Mara; disclosure may cost companionship and restitution cannot purchase forgiveness|5,20,35,40,41|Fibi asks her to leave; Mara refuses reunion; she must obey both rather than perform redemption|Drawling wagers and deflections; jokes stop when a victim names a fact; plain verbs in testimony|Cleans the cylinder after rain and keeps losing at games she insists were practice|Gives testimony and restitution, accepts a fair loss, remains answerable and is not universally forgiven

Maeve|Make her family's failed craft useful again|That asking reveals she cannot solve everything|A technically excellent repair is necessarily a kindness|Forge tolerances, load-bearing fittings and patient practical instruction|Removes Hina's valued patch without permission and must undo her own competent work|6,7,10,33,35|Hina contradicts her repair instinct; she learns to work under another person's brief|Concrete material verbs, occasional three-part lists; exasperation is physical rather than a continuous joke|Saves failed test pieces and labels why they failed instead of selling them|Forges the requested fitting, keeps the failed pieces, helps teach rather than claiming Nil as a creation

Hina|Have a future that includes ordinary wishes and recognition|Fading and being treated as a provisional imitation|Court certification or turning100 will finally make her worthy of care|Remembers shrine routes, object vows and social debts others overlook|Her desperation makes Tamamo's coercive offer tempting; being loved does not let her command anyone to stay unchanged|9,10,12,13,14,49|Ofuku's care includes disagreement; Maeve's patch mistake gives Hina a concrete boundary to defend|Formal flourishes collapse into childish excitement; short unadorned sentences when truly frightened|Has strong preferences about umbrella storage and which familiar patch faces the door|Claims personhood at99, participates in care for others, celebrates100 only after the year jump

Jinling|Keep shelter and credit functioning while ending predatory claims|A panic that destroys workers' wages and gives her father justification|A benevolent owner can correct injustice privately without sharing power|Contract comparison, reserve liquidity, negotiation and hidden copies|Her charity preserves hierarchy and Nil's error occurs under her protection; she must expose her own risk and surrender sole oversight|15,16,17,20,21,43|Shunya wants publication she considers financially dangerous; depositors distrust both her and her father|Polished conditional offers and playful interest language; becomes exact about whose funds are at risk|Checks staff wages before entertaining guests and likes tea properly cooled rather than theatrically expensive|Funds bounded relief from surplus and accepts contested worker/depositor oversight, not an instant moral crown

Bai Si|Keep a count that does not abandon people when records disagree|That his careful life's work helped conceal actual lives|A clean official total is more respectful than unresolved testimony|Witness comparison, funeral routes, patient preservation of counter-records|Must acknowledge omissions without making dead people specimens for his guilt|17,18,19,26,33|Prima's official logs conflict with living testimony; Kallisto's River-born worker preserves Wen through craft|Few words, careful names, genuine pauses; avoids decorative death aphorisms|Trims lamp wicks and repairs a carrying strap; four lanterns have practical weight|Preserves disputed names and uncertainty, smiles at a particular remembered person, does not declare grief solved

Shunya|Understand the Deficit and publish a defensible contribution|Being wrong after asking others to take personal risks|Equal-looking deficits must encode interchangeable possibilities|Instrument calibration, independent comparison and falsifiable modelling|Her initial model fails timing; professional ambition can overrun consent or expose private accounts|22,23,24,26,28|Jinling disputes publication; Vidya challenges her assumptions without withdrawing employment|Thinks in provisional clauses and revises aloud; explains one example before terminology; loses fluency when personally ashamed|Has to negotiate paid instrument time and washes ink from cuffs badly|Retains the failed model in the appendix and accepts limited revocable co-authorship rather than owning a discovery-person

Prima|Protect a city through the institution that trained her|Losing colleagues, shelter and the identity that made her useful|A temporary lawful exclusion cannot make her responsible for its consequences|Shield placement, evacuation discipline, route logs and geometric limits|Previously denied a family passage; defection does not erase the record or earn Kallisto's immediate welcome|29,30,31,32,35|Kallisto directs repairs and testimony; Bai Si challenges the belief that a log exhausts the truth|Formal recitation under pressure, then increasingly personal subjects and active verbs; earnestness need not be stupidity|Knows the roster of people on her watch and folds the former uniform instead of pretending it never existed|Testifies, works under residents' direction and saves the teacher without restoring his authority

Fibi|Choose a road beyond the casino and train as a surveyor|Another dawn controlled by someone else's promise|Only perfectly repeating familiar routines can keep her safe enough to choose|Remembers iterations, detects deviations and reads a disclosed game quickly|The loop has made anticipation exhausting; she may refuse a conversation without supplying a cheerful alternative|37,38,39,40,41,49|Vesper must leave when asked; the House's familial protection is not permission; Vance corroborates rather than owns recollections|Fast anticipation in familiar scenes, counting breath when distressed; slows when she has no remembered script|Draws unfinished road maps on permitted record paper and wants to find out where an uncharted road actually goes|Ends the clause with informed consent, keeps her memories private when desired and departs with fatigue and plans rather than an instant cure

Varro|Obtain effective care for Livia|Being unable to protect her after abandoning his office|Harming another debtor can be justified as one last necessary collection|Understands warrant routes, jar custody and the office's practical weak points|His seizures have victims; Nil's mercy does not excuse them and Livia rejects his proposed bargain|7,42,49|Livia refuses the exemption he wants to purchase; Nought insists care is not contingent on Varro serving the party|Clipped claim language and commands; after removal of the mask he still struggles to ask instead of order|Maintains jar latches obsessively and has kept an undelivered repair for his sister's window|A late guest who offers restitution and later works at the shelter without replacing Livia's decisions

Livia|Receive treatment without another family paying through a seizure|That her illness will always be used to justify violence she rejects|Keeping disagreement quiet will spare Varro pain|Tracks symptoms, correspondence and what promised care actually supplies|Her refusal strains a relationship on which her transport currently depends; she cannot simply walk out alone|6,21,42,49|Varro must hear no; Gus and Nought coordinate with her instructions rather than treating her as cargo|Specific observations, dry impatience at euphemisms, questions addressed to the clinician rather than through her brother|Keeps a date-marked symptom log and requests a view of ordinary street movement|Consents to medical transfer and co-runs the shelter with authority to disagree; no magical instant cure

Thale|Prevent catastrophic loss by making allocation predictable|Another street lost while he could have intervened|Only concentrated executive control can make safety dependable|Emergency logistics, records and real evidence of protected-route benefits|Rejects decentralization, conceals costs and knowingly attempts to erase Nil and freeze future choice|4,21,28,46,47,48,49|Ivo's loyalty changes into testimony; the Board's rejected proposal makes concealment a choice; beneficiaries also have claims|Calm complete sentences, names concrete benefits, avoids cartoon threats; becomes directive when consent would limit power|Cooks a single dinner and performs small useful tasks without witnesses; tenderness does not cancel policy|Surrenders executive control, preserves records and faces public proceedings; survival is not acquittal

Hap|Participate in possibility again|Extinguished chance and repetition without choice|Surprise is sufficiently good to justify uneven dealing|Can perceive possibility through the shared substrate but cannot fix ordinary material scarcity|Its former unfairness harmed people; release cannot restore unaccountable divine allocation|7,14,21,28,35,42,45,49|Nil demands an answer about those harmed by free chance; local keepers retain identities and are not Hap's disguises|Playful brief questions in dreams; admits limits directly after45; never an omniscient plot lecturer|Dream forms vary but dice eyes recur; physical captivity is withheld until45|Freed participation subject to disclosed channels and other people's refusal; neither ruler nor guaranteed benevolence

Ama|Deliver paid work and keep Tobi safe without accepting a false debt|A final seizure that prevents ordinary transport and care|An honest receipt will automatically make an official listen|Skilled mending, saved materials and clear chronology of her own payment|Defending the receipt exposes her vulnerability in public, but she does not become merely grateful scenery|1,2,49|Tobi carries real responsibility but is still a child; Baker risks assistance without owning the rescue|Measured practical questions; insists on dates and copies; affection shown through ordinary instructions|Collects usable thread and checks a repaired seam before sending it out|Keeps her work and receipt, participates in the Wards' witness network and does not owe Nil lifelong service

Tobi|Help Ama deliver work and be taken seriously|Not understanding danger adults suddenly stop explaining|A clever shortcut or carrying something heavy proves he can handle every task|Observes hands and changes in adult posture; knows local stairs|Needs protection and can misunderstand the reason adults withhold information|1,2,49|Ama permits useful responsibility; Baker's bun handoff is an ordinary gift, not a prophecy|Solemn literal jokes, specific questions and occasional unfinished speech when frightened|Collects bottle caps and changes his mind about jobs without shame|Remains a child; renews an already completed Naming in the epilogue rather than belatedly turning seven

Baker|Keep the stall open and neighbours fed without losing its stock|Official attention that closes the livelihood others rely on|Small quiet help can always remain politically invisible|Baking, price judgement, noticing hunger and a practical lead to Gus|Helping the family and paying the unfinished bowl bargain risk scrutiny; no obligation to become a resistance saint|1,2|Ama is a working neighbour; Tobi receives the bun as a courier of care, not a mascot|Brisk dry exchanges about actual food and work; no uniform speech about fate|Separates damaged stock, keeps water and bowls useful, notices weather through the oven schedule|Continues ordinary work; the stall supplies witness contact rather than a magical endless free meal

Collector|Execute a warrant without a discrepancy reaching a supervisor|Being blamed for an office's mismatched forms|Procedure separates responsibility for a harmful outcome from the person enacting it|Case seals, authorized routes and the difference between old and new stamps|Continues the seizure despite seeing the mismatch; calls a Hound when NaN exceeds his category|1,2|Ama is a credible claimant he chooses not to hear; Varro illustrates another form of the same office, not this man's secret identity|Polite passive constructions and narrow questions; no need to shout to threaten|Dries his papers carefully and checks a worn stamp by touch|Retained as a witnessed agent in the disputed seizure record; not silently killed or redeemed by being procedural

Debt Hound|Follow its programmed warrant target and route restrictions|No personal fear: a machine's limits are not motives|No belief or human moral transformation is attributed to it|Four stamp feet, reserve vessel, muzzle and a readable signal path|Its machinery can injure people and damage repairs; defeating it does not heal or punish a living dog|2,3,5,6|Collector command and service maintenance, not pack loyalty|Mechanical sounds and explicit public notices; no inner monologue|Requires fuel, latches and repairs rather than supernatural emotional hunger|Evaded or mechanically disabled as scheduled; no creature-death melodrama

cart resident|Save the washing and keep a neighbour's lane passable|A broken cart or official penalty she cannot afford|Remaining outside a dispute guarantees safety|Knows cart balance, gate reach and the courtyard's narrow clearances|Moving the linen cart risks equipment and stock; help is finite and physical|3|Her work supports neighbours including Baker; her decision is not an order from Nil|Short urgent instructions followed by a specific complaint about damaged washing|Checks wheels and rations dry space under the eaves|Becomes a possible witness through the Wards network; not transported into the travelling party

Nought|Keep a place where shelter does not require spiritual or financial surrender|That his old institutional habits will turn care into another test|A benevolent guide can recognize what another person should choose|Basic first aid, old record practice and a distributed shelter network|Must disclose the Naming's connection risk and accept Nil leaving; cannot trade shelter for cooperation|3,4,21,42,49|Gus coordinates material transport; Ofuku is an independent keeper, not his subordinate; Livia directs her own care|Warm concrete offers with tired humour; direct warnings instead of mysterious instructions|Moves a leaking pan, repairs a chair and shares food without performing a sermon|Continues shelter and witness work; knows the outlawed tradition but not the physical cage before its discovery

Gus|Keep a repair trade solvent and eventually revisit his Crossroads home|A bad guarantee or courier failure hurting someone who trusted him|A personal favour can remain separate from the system that prices it|Straps, charm frames, source checks and paid courier contacts|Uses limited funds and reputation for care; must not be everywhere at once to resolve a plot gap|6,21,42|Nought shares logistics; Maeve can dispute a repair price; Livia's log outranks an exemption slogan|Haggles about parts and labour, shifts to plain dates and routes for medical transport|Records what each repair actually does and refuses counterfeit guarantees|Coordinates Meridian dispatches from established contacts; homecoming is not an unexplained teleport to every hub

Ivo|Make a correction that cannot be quietly withdrawn|That public testimony will expose his own years of compliance|Copies alone discharge responsibility without action|Archive routing, independent copy chains and internal service access|Supplying the rejected proposal and opening the passage puts his position and safety at risk|4,20,21,44,46,49|Thale is a superior he once admired; workers need the records more than his claim of good intentions|Careful qualifiers and exact document names; active first-person testimony when he defects|Preserves counter-copies rather than collecting secret knowledge for its own sake|Defects through an earned route, testifies under the same review he enables and receives no automatic immunity

Tetsu|Complete a safe paid crossing and keep distance from former enforcement|That passengers will confuse leaving an office with undoing its harms|Silence about the past can protect everyone from repeating it|Hull maintenance, currents, knots and fee records|A delay costs passengers time; the old uniform seam exposes a past he cannot erase|8,14|Ofuku's shrine route depends on ferry access; former Collector colleagues still recognize his workmanship|Sparse useful instructions, little appetite for dramatic confession|Checks rope before taking money and repairs a line before discussing its symbolism|Keeps the local route and witness address open; partial disclosure does not claim absolution

Ofuku|Keep care possible for old objects and visitors with conflicting needs|Having to decide what cannot be repaired this season|Keeping a familiar form is always the kindest preservation|Vow care, storage, budgeting scarce repair labour and local witness copies|Must permit Hina's disagreement and distribute attention beyond a beloved companion|10,14,49|Hina can argue over storage and departure; Tetsu's access limits affect the queue|Practical elderly impatience, specific memories and occasional unfinished chores rather than endless wisdom|Paints one daruma eye for a concrete visitor and keeps a repair list|An elderly human keeper who shares local stewardship without becoming an oracle for Nil's origin

Enma|Preserve an account that rulers cannot force him to falsify|An exception becoming permission to declare anyone nonexistent|A complete ledger is equivalent to complete knowledge|Defines a safe trial and certifies exactly what his own record shows|Must name the limits of his jurisdiction when Nil has no entry|11,14|Ofuku preserves a counter-copy; Judge Cui later supplies independent evidence, not a redundant copy of Enma's authority|Formal precise scope; refuses a stronger conclusion than the evidence supports|Inspects bindings and returns a book to its place after a difficult hearing|Certifies absence from his record without judging Nil soulless; keeper survives

Ao|Keep Tamamo and the court's dependents protected|A rapid change abandoning people the court actually shelters|Court continuity is the same as safety|Paired foxfire coordination and palace access rules|Can obstruct refugees while calling it protection|12,13,14|Aka disagrees over the promise; neither twin speaks as half of a single mind|Measured paired replies, begins with obligations before doubts|Checks the route and messages before serving a court ritual|Accepts a witnessed care agreement while retaining loyalty to people beyond Tamamo

Aka|Allow a changing future without betraying dependents|Being blamed for a collapse after challenging the court|Revealing a contradiction automatically provides a practical replacement|Detects illusion edges and listens to unofficial reports|Doubt can leave Ao carrying all immediate responsibility|12,13,14|Ao demands a care plan rather than a clever objection; Hina makes the price personal|Sharper interruptions and questions that break the paired cadence when stakes rise|Revises a message rather than pretending an old promise never existed|Shares the new route work; one tail and opposite-side ponytail remain the same identity

Tamamo|Stop the fading of people for whom she feels responsible|Presiding over another disappearance|Permanence imposed on someone is preferable to a future in which they may be lost|Court negotiation, real shelter infrastructure and bounded illusions|Offers Nil's surrender as a price others would pay; genuine fear does not excuse coercion|12,13,14|Ao and Aka are retainers with differing views; Ofuku's practical care challenges the court's monopoly|Ceremonial warmth with carefully limited offers; drops ornament when admitting a loss|Maintains actual restoration rosters instead of grieving only in a throne room|Survives defeat, yields monopoly access and participates in contested stewardship without becoming instantly harmless

Little Lantern|Reliable shelter and a future that is not priced as message speed|That accepting help means losing freedom to leave|A stolen object is the only leverage adults respect|Harbour routes, accurate delivery and recognizing a changed instruction|Stealing the charm risks trust even when he returns it with information|15,21,49|Jinling must offer ongoing care through explicit agreement, not acquire him with a bounty|Quick concrete bargains and observations about routes; not an exposition child who knows every secret|Keeps delivery fees separately from other people's deposits|Receives stable care with his participation in the arrangement; household belonging is not an ownership transfer

Jin Chan|Keep credit flowing under the Exchange he controls|A run that proves his methods cannot protect his own family|Only private ownership with decisive power can prevent financial collapse|Prices risk, manages inventory and knows whose claims can delay others|Predatory exclusions and hidden debits benefit his office; losing an Audit does not pay everyone's debts|20,21,49|Jinling hears his fear but rejects inheriting sole authority; depositors have claims independent of their family|Jovial calculation becomes defensive accounting; avoids a generic miser sneer|Reads warehouse reports and notices a delayed shipment before entertaining petitioners|Lives under review after losing monopoly control; relinquishment does not erase legal obligations

Ox-Head|Keep dangerous crossings bounded and coordinated|A hurried exception becoming harm to another traveller|Only simultaneous formal compliance can prove cooperation|Physical gate timing and stated trial objectives|Must provide refusal and cancellation rather than force worship through injury|18|Horse-Face can challenge an unsafe interpretation of their shared rule|Brief paired conditions, no taunting at the dead|Maintains a crossing mechanism that must function for ordinary travellers|Bows when the objective is met and remains a keeper, not a corpse or a recruited weapon

Horse-Face|Bring travellers through a valid trial without separating vulnerable parties|Rules being applied one person at a time to defeat their purpose|An explicit rule always anticipates every circumstance|Watches timing and communicates the paired condition|Has to clarify an ambiguous instruction before enforcing it|18|Ox-Head shares responsibility; neither silently corrects the other's error after the fact|Precise restatement and confirmation rather than identical twin dialogue|Checks the return route as carefully as the entry|Recognizes the completed cooperation and preserves the trial record

Judge Cui|Permit a correction without destroying its evidence|That a beautiful new account will erase someone whose copy is inconvenient|A valid amendment can be certified without considering who retains access|Brush rules, witnesses and counter-record preservation|Must refuse an unsafe shortcut even when Nil's cause is sympathetic|19|Bai Si brings disagreement; Enma's independent jurisdiction limits any universal answer|Careful verbs distinguishing erase, amend and preserve|Cleans and rests the brush between claims instead of performing ceaseless magic|Authorizes bounded Rewrite and preserves the counter-record; revered role is not an enemy target

Wen|During life, make a ferry rope someone else could trust|A failed splice injuring a passenger|His life is not reduced to a moral lesson inferred from his death|Rope craft survives in a work knot and dated testimony|He is dead; a correct count cannot return his future to his family|17,18,26,33|Descendants and River-born workers preserve craft without pretending to be current eyewitnesses of an ancient death|Quoted work instructions and preserved testimony only; no omniscient ghost explaining Nil|Specific repairs and a maker's knot identify a life beyond the missing fraction|A disputed life is recorded accurately and remembered; no resurrection or lantern ownership

Vidya Rao|Finish a defensible catalogue and keep the observatory operating|Political suppression and an unsupported result destroying trust|Protecting a promising student requires smoothing away their public mistakes|Independent measurement, calibration and signed dispatches|Must retain Shunya's failed model and pay instrument crews even when publication is dangerous|22,24,27,28,49|Shunya can outgrow his model; Meera's private record is not his departmental property|Patient examples and exact observations; will say he does not know|Schedules instruments around maintenance, weather and the crew's wages|Publishes bounded measurements and a failed-test appendix without claiming Nil's personal data

Meera|Recover her brother's record and keep control of what is shared|That scholars will turn a loss into evidence she cannot retrieve|A complete record may answer every unresolved feeling|Diving lines, depth limits, return planning and retrieval documentation|Risk is physical and paid; agreeing to retrieval is not blanket publication consent|22,23,24,49|Shunya needs her permission; Vidya's institutional archive must return the private original|Specific depth and safety instructions; grief changes the subject rather than becoming an explanatory speech|Checks lamp seals and does not enter water because a protagonist is impatient|Receives the record, permits a limited comparison and keeps grief without an invented cure

Chitragupta|Keep deeds legible without converting a person into a verdict|A new measurement reproducing an older erasure|Recording more detail necessarily makes a record exhaustive|Compares regional meanings and defines a nonlethal record trial|Must distinguish his account's limits from a claim to own the subject|24,25|Shunya's hypothesis is examined rather than blessed; Meera's record has an owner|Formal distinctions grounded in a particular entry, not a lecture on an entire real religion|Preserves a counter-copy and the unanswered question beside it|Supplies independent evidence without becoming Hap in disguise or a defeated enemy

Kallisto|Safe access and authority for the residents maintaining the city|A celebrated outsider leaving residents with broken routes and reprisals|Immediate unity is always necessary to win a hearing|Organizes labour, local knowledge, witnesses and practical evacuation|Can pressure dissenting residents to accept one plan; must record their disagreement|30,31,33,35,43,49|Prima owes testimony before trust; Maeve works under local repair priorities|Names a task, responsible person and deadline; anger is specific rather than constant rhetoric|Checks a support before accepting a speech about the upper city|Residents govern reopened routes and can challenge the proposed transition rather than thank the party and disappear

Niko|Do something useful in a city that overlooks him|Being treated as a joke whenever a task fails|Being a hero means taking a risk alone|Knows goats and narrow routes adults do not use|His mistakes must not turn actual falls or children in danger into recurring slapstick|29,30,31|Kallisto can assign safe useful work; Prima must respect a child's information without handing him a soldier's duty|Eager specific claims, often corrected by an escaped goat rather than by contempt|Counts animals and learns where a weak terrace edge really leads|Helps identify a safe route under adult responsibility and remains a child

Clotho|Establish a sequence everyone understands before acting|An interrupted order that traps the next participant|An elegant sequence remains safe without checking comprehension|Spinning and observable ordered trials|Must restart an unclear instruction rather than blame a traveller for misreading|32|Lachesis checks the relationships the sequence assumes; Atropos defines its ending boundary|Measured instructions with one explicit example|Adjusts tension before asking someone to put a hand near the wheel|Certifies a bounded trial, not authority over the party's entire future

Lachesis|Measure a shared obligation without ranking lives|Measurement being used to claim a person's ownership|Participants who agree to a trial agree to every later use of its record|Measured thread, witnessed limits and record custody|Must separate trial consent from the finale's later request|32,35,43,49|Prima and Nil reason through a disagreement; Clotho cannot substitute compliance for permission|Questions about scope, followed by a precise statement of what the strand records|Repairs a measuring mark rather than secretly moving it|Releases the witnessed thread with limits; Prima retains authority over final use

Atropos|Make a real ending possible without disguised coercion|A costly choice being passed off as voluntary because alternatives were hidden|A sacrifice appears more honest when it hurts more|States permitted substitutions and closure conditions|Must provide the expendable ribbon explicitly and never consume a protected proof or person|32|Clotho's sequence and Lachesis's record need a declared end, not an arbitrary severing|Plain questions and unromantic descriptions of consequences|Keeps discarded test ribbon separate from live records|Accepts a bounded material cost, no demanded companion death or erased evidence

Archon|Preserve the ranked city and the authority that maintains it|Admission that excluded residents built the stability he claims|Numerical qualification can establish political worth|Knows geometric machinery and the institution's access rules|His exclusions and school order endanger children; saving him does not restore his office|29,30,34,35,49|Prima was a sincere student, not an idiot he deceived in every lesson; Kallisto's witnesses challenge his jurisdiction|Didactic complete assertions; cites a real working structure before applying its false moral conclusion|Inspects a functioning shelter while refusing to recognize who was excluded from it|Survives under witness custody and public review after losing monopoly power

Stranger|Make a declared bargain possible to refuse|A signature obtained through hidden terms being called an agreement|A formally fair offer always accounts for unequal bargaining power|Discloses stakes and teaches a bounded Deal without cheating|Must allow the exhausted party to decline rather than make entry conditional on submission|36|Vesper knows fair play requires exposure of her own methods; the House offers the contrasting imposed contract|Few words, asks what the traveller thinks they are offering|Sets down the book so both parties can see the same page|Remains a keeper of bounded terms rather than a villain revealed by a trick

Penny|Leave the railway without losing the record of the nights|That spending a token will erase what she has kept|A count by itself can settle the obligation holding her|Recognizes authorized counters and the sequence of repeated departures|Tokens are nonspendable records, not a source of newly created money|38,41,49|Vance checks the count against case markers; Fibi can contradict Penny's remembered sequence|Patient recurring phrases interrupted by exact corrections|Sorts tokens by worn edges, not increasing magical purchasing power|The clause's cancellation permits departure; no literal extra currency must be minted to free her

Vance|Make a charge stick against property power without inventing evidence|Losing public authority and leaving staff less protected|One impeccable case file can act without witnesses who are allowed to disagree|Separates case records, property claims and signed testimony|Her office relies on House credit and retained markers; she must disclose those dependencies|38,39,40,41,49|Penny corroborates but does not replace Fibi; staff can dispute her proposed settlement|Specific questions, dates and contradictions; no all-knowing frontier drawl|Notches authorized case markers and keeps ordinary wage complaints in the same office|Preserves cancellation and restitution evidence and accepts public oversight rather than simply arresting away an economy

House|Keep Fibi safe while retaining the property network that defines his competence|Losing her and discovering that protection caused the harm|Buying protection entitles him to control its beneficiary|Contracts, funding, bounded rewinds and real staff logistics|Commissioned the protection when Fibi was15; continuing control at18 drains her and employees depend on his assets|39,40,41,49|Fibi's refusal limits family authority; Vance and staff hold independent claims he cannot settle with affection|Affable offers with conditions; uses family terms to evade a precise consent question|Knows the cost of a replacement felt table and ignores an excluded person's larger cost|Lives after relinquishing the claim; signs the cancellation and faces wage/property proceedings

Mara|Have her family's chosen restitution recognized without performing forgiveness|That Vesper will turn her survival into a redemption story|She is not required to have a corrective flaw to justify refusing contact|Works with a mutual-aid office and can direct how her statement and family fund are handled|Injury, disrupted schooling and displacement remain consequences; no image of recovery cancels them|20,35,40,49|Her family and colleagues exist independently of Vesper; Fibi need not mediate a reunion|Direct boundaries and concrete requests; no required cathartic speech to the protagonist|Has work shifts and education outside the scene about what happened to her|Chooses the terms of contact, receives directed restitution and is not obliged to forgive

Brask|Close her assignments without losing a single officer, and keep her crews paid|That an order she carried out will be the one that kills someone she could have warned|A lawful order is its own justification, so long as she writes down what it costs|Pursuit logistics, reading crowds and running linked Collector pairs; meticulous field reports|Enforces seizures and guards the eclipse engines against the party; her linked officers come close to killing Nil before she surrenders the credential|25,27,28|Thale reads her reports and acts on them; her officers trust her more than the office; Nil makes her start asking what her orders cost|Plain, procedural and polite; asks after people's health and means it; never raises her voice|Writes the weather, the fields and the Civic numbers of the people affected into reports nobody asked for|Testifies about seizure orders in the public proceedings and keeps her crews employed under council review; no automatic absolution
